name: two-wallets
description: Two unrelated wallets checked together: each gets a report, plus the links between them.

findings.title: Reused address: 89 transactions sent
findings.detail: Every transaction from one address is linkable to every other one from it. The more trades share an address, the more of your history one lookup reveals.
findings.fix: Trade from a fresh address each time, so one trade can't be joined to the others.

findings.title: No matching in and out amounts in the last ~26 min (blocks 97,722,067–97,737,066)
findings.detail: No outgoing transfer repeats an amount this address received.
findings.fix: Don't pass on the exact amount you received. Split it, keep part, or send in irregular sizes so the two sides can't be paired.

findings.title: No round-amount transfers in the last ~26 min (blocks 97,722,067–97,737,066)
findings.fix: Use irregular sizes (1,037.42 rather than 1,000) so amounts can't be matched across addresses.

findings.title: No fast in-and-out in the last ~26 min (blocks 97,722,067–97,737,066)
findings.detail: No outgoing transfer within 20 blocks (~2 s) of an incoming one.
findings.fix: Leave a longer, random delay between receiving funds and moving them on.
Fund each trading wallet's gas from a source that isn't tied to your other wallets, not straight from your main wallet.
findings.title: Funded by a busy wallet 0x88D2…51d3
findings.detail: The first ETH came from 0x88D25C861938a91AF4ad57aD964a8fCc6c6351d3, which has sent 98,566 transactions (an exchange, bot or hot wallet). That hides you in a crowd publicly, but its operator can link you.

findings.title: 1 sender also funded other addresses in the last ~26 min (blocks 97,722,067–97,737,066)
findings.detail: 0x915A0C3EE1D8bB4489203EFCC8524d00b57E0d8c paid 669 other addresses. Addresses paid by the same sender are easy to cluster together.
findings.fix: Don't fund trading wallets from one shared source; each one funded from the same address is linked to the rest.

findings.title: Nobody followed more than one of 2 trades
findings.detail: For each recent swap output, the same token from the same source went to 0, 0 other address(es) in the next 100 blocks (~10 s), but no address did so twice. One follower on a popular token is noise; repeats are the signal.
findings.fix: Copy-trade bots key on a known wallet. Trades from fresh addresses give them nothing to follow.

findings.title: Gas funder: not checked
findings.detail: Only plain wallets (EOAs) are searched: a contract or EIP-7702 account can move ETH without its nonce.

findings.title: No shared funders in the last ~26 min (blocks 97,722,067–97,737,066)

links.title: No links between the 2 wallets
links.detail: No transfers between them, no shared gas funder and no shared token sender in the window.
links.fix: Keep the wallets apart: no transfers between them, and separate funding for each.
